scope: Trusted owner WC stroke; selected callback gate delays either real accepted IDB-delete notification (default), or actual ACK with <5s timing guard; real UI board switch, old-board dedup and no new-board mutation
deviceScope: Single real AMD Vega GPU, trusted CDP pen, actual owner board switching; shared QA backend under unrelated CPU correctness suite, no latency benchmark
limitations: Native IDB transaction is committed normally; QA delays only completion callback resolving delete promise. This tests retirement after accepted ACK, not an ACK response delayed beyond send timeout.
